title: Persist text-free responses and resume interrupted model runs
description:
## Scope

Key successful responses by full state/question fingerprints plus model/version and transport-relevant configuration. Store run/dataset revision, condition, example IDs, ordering, draw, target manifest ID, structured raw answers, available probabilities, usage, latency, attempt outcome, and failure metadata. Never store source text or credentials; retry only eligible failures under the ceiling.

## Definition of done

Fake-client specs prove crashes/resumes reuse complete successful responses, changed examples/order/task/model invalidate cache hits, malformed responses remain identifiable, and secret sentinels never enter artifacts.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Persist text-free responses and resume interrupted model runs
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given a run has cached successful responses and an interrupted attempt
    When the run resumes with the same matrix
    Then only missing or retryable cells are attempted and every attempt is counted
```

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-ce360969-5b44-554d-ba77-d4a38dbd7de1`.
